technology_name: Portable Biosensor for Detection of Food Borne Bacteria
problem_solved: Enables rapid detection of food-borne pathogens and contaminants.
description: Portable biosensor with disposable 1 in x 1 in chip for detection of food borne bacteria. Validated with Salmonella, E Coli O157:H7, Shigella, etc.  Jointly developed by C-MET Thrissur and Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology(RGCB),Thiruvananthapuram
applications:
Food safety testing laboratories and quality assurance agencies
Food processing, packaging, and export industries
Restaurants, catering services, and commercial food supply chains
Public health, regulatory, and food inspection authorities
Biotechnology, diagnostics, and biosensor manufacturing companies
